claims.statement: The runner-group wrapper includes the fully inspected Actions fragment leading through Actions to Runner groups. This is navigation, not a complete runner-group inventory, repository/workflow authorization, available capacity, actual isolation or permission to allocate compute.

The runner wrapper includes the fully inspected Actions fragment leading through Actions to Runners. This does not distinguish live runner hosting modes, prove availability or health, identify installed agents, allocate a runner or authorize costs.

Organizations are shared collaboration accounts supporting multiple projects and administrative/security features. Shared organizational containers must not be interpreted as shared personal login credentials; previously reviewed account context separates personal sign-in identities. This descriptive summary proves no actual organization, feature entitlement, enforced security or universal architecture mandate.
Moderators is reached through Moderation in the Access sidebar. Navigation is not a moderator assignment, full privilege definition, complete moderation inventory or authorized content action.

The inspected Teams include opens the organization Teams tab, after which the named team is selected. The caption identifies the tab without image inspection. Selecting a team is not creation, membership verification, effective permission calculation or authority to alter it.

The sponsorship-management procedure starts on the desired organization's main page. The pinned product_location variable resolves to the user's GHES instance in the GHES branch and GitHub.com otherwise; that generic navigation does not independently prove sponsorship availability on every product or identify a live host. No sponsorship, payment, financial record or spending authority was accessed.
